assignments.name: verdict
assignments.value: Free, impressive, slow. Worth one hero figure on your landing page if customers struggle to picture what you sell; skip it for charts, quick graphics or a tight usage cap.

assignments.name: cost
assignments.value: Skill free (MIT), no API keys. You pay in agent time: the maker reports 1 h 54 min to 14 h per figure.

assignments.name: install
assignments.value: npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy -g -a claude-code (Node 22.20+), or git clone into ~/.claude/skills/anatomy
